evals.prompt: The confirmation banner takes 200ms to fetch the order ID asynchronously after element visibility. Write the spec assertion using CheckoutPage.
evals.expected_output: Use web-first retrying locator assertion: await expect(pages.checkout.orderIdBanner).toHaveText(/^ORD-\d+$/).
